github.scope: Read-only GitHub peer research for public publication of daxuan-science-assets. Observations are from current README/SKILL/source-tree responses; no peer was installed, executed, or visually rendered.
methods: gh api contents API decoding current README and SKILL.md

candidates.name: scientific-schematics
observed_facts: Natural-language scientific diagrams use Nano Banana 2 generation and Gemini review through OpenRouter.
The SKILL explicitly states PNG-only raster output, no vector path and no DPI control.
Source-backed labels and relationships, final-size manual inspection, retained versions and review logs are required in the documented workflow.
The guide shows a workflow PNG and labels its example as illustrative rather than a validated scientific figure.
Repository README documents npx skills add and gh skill install. SKILL declares Python 3.10+, requests, network, and an API key.
candidates.installation_observed: npx skills add K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills; select the named skill using supported installer UI/options.
candidates.showcase_observed: Task-focused guide includes a workflow image and output/interpretation tables.
candidates.provenance_observed: Requires supported components and relationships; records prompt, review, image versions and stop reason. API IDs are documented as catalog-checked and offline-contract-tested rather than paid end-to-end-tested.
candidates.practical_lesson: Lead with the delivered format and its limits; retain source/brief and evidence alongside any image-model draft.
candidates.do_not_copy: Do not inherit the PNG pipeline or external reviewer as proof of editable SVG or scientific validity.

candidates.name: scientific-visualization
observed_facts: Focuses on truthful data figures, journal export planning and palette/contrast review.
SKILL requires a destination, final width, variable semantics, transformations and provenance before implementation.
Explicitly separates universal figure principles from live publisher specifications.
Bundled local CLIs are described as network-free; scientific dependencies load only where needed.
Repository contains a palette audit CLI, publisher profiles, source references, test scripts and a dedicated guide image.
candidates.installation_observed: The repository-level npx skills add / gh skill install entry points also cover this skill.
candidates.showcase_observed: Repository contains docs/images/scientific-visualization.png; its visual appearance was not reviewed here.
candidates.provenance_observed: Raw data, transformations, missing values, exclusions and seeds are protected; publisher compliance is not inferred from a palette or automated report.
candidates.practical_lesson: Make final destination size, semantic color meanings and assumptions explicit before palette harmonization.
candidates.do_not_copy: Statistical chart workflows are adjacent, not a replacement for source-backed method-diagram and reusable-asset authoring.

candidates.name: scipilot-figure-skill
observed_facts: README introduces a visualization advisor that profiles data before recommending and drawing charts.
SKILL explicitly excludes schematics, flowcharts and architecture diagrams.
Documents a render-preview, program-audit and AI-read-image loop; ships visual_qa.py and layout_tools.py.
Lists final-size typography, vector export and redundant color encoding rules.
README gives English and Chinese usage, clone installation and Python dependencies.
candidates.installation_observed: git clone into an agent skills directory, then pip install -r requirements.txt.
candidates.showcase_observed: README contains four request-and-behavior examples and workflow text; no final scientific image was visibly embedded in the fetched README.
candidates.provenance_observed: Data profiling, sample size, uncertainty and significance-test explanations precede chart rendering.
candidates.practical_lesson: Keep deterministic checks and actual rendered inspection separate; offer concrete input-to-output examples.
candidates.do_not_copy: Do not borrow its broad chart scope or treat its journal preset recommendations as venue acceptance.

candidates.name: svg-diagram
observed_facts: Agent draws hand-placed native SVG under explicit geometry, typography and color rules.
Root SKILL and dependency-free Node linter are installed together.
README embeds ten SVG gallery examples, with each caption explaining a specific rule.
Linter reads final SVG and reports check IDs, observed values and concrete repair guidance.
Its style intentionally requires a white canvas rectangle for dark-mode readability.
candidates.showcase_observed: Embedded native SVG house-style image plus ten rule-oriented gallery diagrams; no render test was run in this research.
candidates.provenance_observed: Literal coordinates, semantic palette rules and final-artifact linting are documented; no scientific evidence extraction is claimed.
candidates.practical_lesson: Show actual editable outputs near the installation command; make failing checks actionable and lint the file that users receive.
candidates.do_not_copy: Its mandatory white canvas conflicts with transparent reusable materials. Use separate display previews without changing the transparent delivery.

candidates.name: pretty-mermaid
observed_facts: Local browser-free renderer produces SVG, PNG and terminal text from retained Mermaid source.
README opens with install command and visual preview, then theme gallery and exact CLI examples.
SKILL documents --transparent for SVG and PNG, explicit colors, font, padding and diagram spacing.
Workflow requires saving .mmd source, preserving domain labels, rendering and inspecting output.
README describes six supported diagram families and Node.js 16+ requirement.
candidates.showcase_observed: Social preview PNG, linked fifteen-theme gallery, embedded SVG theme pair and bundled .mmd templates.
candidates.provenance_observed: Original diagram source is kept beside outputs; renderer limitations must be reported rather than silently omitted.
candidates.practical_lesson: Publish a minimal working example with exact commands and clearly state the supported diagram forms and transparency controls.
candidates.do_not_copy: A Mermaid renderer does not supply scientific biological illustrations, infer method correctness or extract evidence from papers.

publication_recommendations: Position daxuan-science-assets around transparent, editable, source-backed scientific materials and slot-aware methodology diagrams; avoid a general charting claim.
Put two genuine reproducible SVG examples and a separate display preview in the README before detailed architecture.
Document a no-credentials native-SVG quick start plus optional image-backend route, and identify which parts have actual execution evidence.
Keep an explicit boundary between structural/alpha/palette checks, visual inspection, scientific evidence verification and third-party editor import.
Publish portable synthetic examples with provenance, exact regeneration commands and no private paper screenshots or local paths.
limitations: No peer install, test suite, paid model call or editor import was performed. Repository claims about test counts and runtime support were not independently validated.
No third-party code, text passages or artwork were copied into the Skill.
GitHub default-branch contents may change after the recorded commit.

catalogs.task: Read-only catalog peer research for daxuan-science-assets publication
catalogs.method: curl -L with 20-25 second timeout, ClawHub public search API, GitHub read-only gh api; page text and repository file tree inspection. No peer installed, generation invoked, or content copied.

channels.name: skills.sh
channels.note: Scientific schematics and canvas-design listings expose explicit installation commands, source repositories, and source Skill text. Old K-Dense repository slug canonicalizes to scientific-agent-skills.

channels.name: ClawHub
channels.note: Public API returned real scientific candidates; SciDraw listing was opened and its complete Skill text inspected. The initial /skills?search=scientific URL showed an unfiltered list, so search API used instead.

channels.name: Tessl
channels.note: Legacy /registry/skills?query=scientific redirects to unfiltered discovery (source has zero scientific terms); urllib received 403 once, curl route worked. No directly matching scientific SVG Skill established here. Opened a linked craft exemplar rather than treating unfiltered search as a match.

candidates.name: scientific-schematics
candidates.position: Scientific diagram drafts with external image generation and automated visual review.
candidates.discoverability: Clear scientific name and page overview; listing includes installation command and source repository.
candidates.showcase: Dedicated workflow guide and PNG at docs/images/scientific-schematics.png; guide states exactly what user supplies and receives.
candidates.learn: Pair a visible result with a short input/output story, versioned artifacts, and honest limitations.
candidates.caveat: Guide explicitly calls outputs raster drafts, without editable vector paths; requires OpenRouter and review/generation external calls. Automated visual review does not verify scientific correctness.

candidates.name: canvas-design
candidates.position: Aesthetic design philosophy followed by a polished visual canvas.
candidates.discoverability: Short recognizable name, concise summary, Design & UI category, source Skill text and source repository.
candidates.showcase: Catalog first screen describes exact MD/PDF/PNG deliverables and a two-step workflow; inspected repository folder contains Skill, license, and fonts, with no dedicated screenshot/GIF in that folder.
candidates.learn: Make typography, whitespace, and color discipline visible in the first screen; clearly name final formats.
candidates.caveat: PDF/PNG art focus; no transparent editable SVG contract or paper-evidence graph. Its creative philosophy should not replace scientific source fidelity.

candidates.name: SciDraw AI Scientific Illustration
candidates.position: Plan and generate paper figures through SciDraw AI web app/API.
candidates.discoverability: Explicit scientific illustration title, topic tags, audience/use cases, install prompt, backend/configuration instructions.
candidates.showcase: Live Skill listing links official drawing UI, API docs, key creation page, and a Python invocation; inspected listing did not display a generated SVG example.
candidates.learn: Name the backend, specify configuration, state output acceptance criteria, and return clear API errors without leaking keys.
candidates.caveat: Service-specific API key and account credits; raster PNG workflow and paid-generation confirmation. Its publication-ready description is not evidence of verified scientific accuracy or editable SVG.

candidates.name: charmedimsure / charmed-vhs
candidates.position: Source-verified agent Skills for the Charm terminal stack, including reproducible demo recordings.
candidates.discoverability: Versioned public registry entry; short summary, skill list, explicit cross-agent installation instructions, linked examples.
candidates.showcase: README surfaced on Tessl explains that cited Go examples are pinned and CI-built; charmed-vhs offers textual .tape sources for reproducible demos. Registry shows quality/eval/security panels. No independent rerun of its examples was performed.
candidates.learn: Publish demo source alongside generated showcase, keep standalone installed skills licensed, and distinguish evaluated snippets from marketing claims.
candidates.caveat: Terminal/Golang ecosystem, no scientific SVG functionality. Registry quality scores apply to that listing and must not be borrowed as validation of our Skill.

catalogs.publication_implication: Position daxuan-science-assets around source-backed, palette-aware, genuinely transparent native SVG components with repeatable render/alpha/recolor checks. Show an install command plus reproducible synthetic input-to-output example, not private Figure screenshots.
limitations: No peer was installed or run; this is interface/source inspection only.
Public raw.githubusercontent.com fetches for three extra README/Skill pages timed out and returned empty data; verified skills.sh/ClawHub/Tessl text and GitHub API routes supply the findings above.
No claim that catalog presence or security badges certify scientific correctness.
